## Problem and result

Describe the problem and the resulting user-visible behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. For native checks, include the Zotero version, OS, artifact version, and isolated profile used. State what was not checked and why. Do not attach private PDFs, profiles, databases, or complete transfer journals.

## Risks and evidence

Describe effects on matching, library data, repeat protection, or undo. Link new evidence separately from frozen historical reports. For documentation-only changes, say so.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and follow CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Relevant automated checks passed, or failures and blockers are explained above.
- [ ] Behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation, English/Russian strings, and the Unreleased changelog are updated where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, private library data, generated packages, or local profiles are included.
